title: Cross-site WebSocket hijacking on /ws with default no-auth deployment
body:
claim: Cross-site WebSocket hijacking on /ws with default no-auth deployment
severity: high
where: meshchatx/src/backend/http/routes/websocket_upgrade.py:138-186, meshchatx/src/backend/http/middleware.py:86-231, meshchatx/meshchat.py:6705-6722
guarantee: A WebSocket upgrade whose Origin is not the local backend origin must be rejected, and a sessionless cross-origin client must not mutate server state
reachability: Any web page visited in any browser on the host while MeshChatX runs with default settings (auth disabled, loopback bind). Browser connects to ws(s)://127.0.0.1:8000/ws. No Origin check, no auth, no CSRF on /ws. Mutators including config.set, lxmf.forwarding.rule.add (message redirection), rns.link.open/identify/send (mesh impersonation) execute. Config broadcast on connect leaks libretranslate_api_key.
oracle_passed=true marker=pytest tests/backend/test_ws_origin_filesync_oracles.py: test_ws_upgrade_rejects_cross_site_origin FAILED (DID NOT RAISE WSServerHandshakeError), test_cross_origin_ws_mutator_does_not_change_state FAILED (probe action persisted to DB) live_passed=false mutation_score= cwe=CWE-346

VALIDATION: ACCEPTED
WARN: mutation_score missing (recommended >= 0.8)
You may draft the finding report. Keep severity honest.

title: FileSync sync-root jail reservation list omits ssl (identity TLS key syncable over mesh)
body:
claim: FileSync sync-root jail reservation list omits ssl (identity TLS key syncable over mesh)
severity: medium
where: meshchatx/src/backend/rns_filesync_handler.py:68-143, meshchatx/meshchat.py:5382-5384
guarantee: The FileSync sync directory must never resolve to identity-tree dirs holding key material (ssl/key.pem)
reachability: Authenticated local UI caller via POST /api/v1/filesync/start or PATCH /api/v1/filesync/settings with sync_directory=<identity_storage>/ssl; mesh peers per FileSync ACL can then fetch key.pem
oracle_passed=true marker=pytest: test_filesync_sync_dir_rejects_identity_ssl_dir FAILED, _resolve_sync_directory returned the ssl path; controls for root and sibling escape passed live_passed=false mutation_score= cwe=CWE-22

VALIDATION: ACCEPTED
